checks.evidence: Adapter test and live verifier create a local template, add a shape, save real OOXML bytes, and reopen with the persisted idPrefix.
Runtime Index reports the stable sceneId and one click-triggered animation batch.
Headless PresentationState advances the saved deck from step 0 to step 1 deterministically.
Local browser session mounted the editor, reopened it after dispose-equivalent rebind, and showed the persisted two-page deck without console warnings/errors.
Production bundle and blank PPTX template are served from ClassCore local-tools assets; no CDN or remote editor runtime is used.

limitations: Published Presentation HTTP API, SQLite playback control, Display reconnect, and Docker/LAN rehearsal remain separate D7 requirements.
